stem:
A construction company notes the time, $t$ days, that it takes to build each house of a certain design.

The results for a random sample of 60 such houses are summarised as follows.

$$\Sigma t = 4820 \qquad \Sigma t^2 = 392\,050$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate a 98% confidence interval for the population mean time.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why it was necessary to use the Central Limit theorem in part **(a)**.
